score.label: Passing score
score.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 5.
score.helpReportOnly: Publishes a neutral check without a score requirement. GitHub can accept neutral checks for merging.
score.helpScore: Paperclip passes the check when a complete review of the latest commit meets this score. Lower scores fail. This does not approve the PR.
score.blockMergingAfter: check from this App in your GitHub branch rules.

instructions.heading: Instructions
instructions.placeholder: What should this agent do on GitHub?
instructions.help: Included in every GitHub task. Type / to select a skill for the agent to use.
instructions.eventHelp: Added to the main instructions for this event. Type / to select a skill for the agent to use.

triggers.heading: When to run
triggers.mentionHelp: Authorized people can always @mention this bot.
triggers.runAutomaticallyDescription: Start work without a mention when an allowed person creates an issue or updates a pull request.
triggers.automaticHelp: Runs for authorized authors in Access. Use the author filters below to limit whose issues and PRs start work.

filters.title: Automatic review filters
filters.includeBotsDescription: The account also needs a sponsor and external-contributor automatic runs enabled in Access.
filters.includedAuthorsHelp: Leave empty for all authorized authors. One username or glob per line.
filters.excludedAuthorsHelp: One username or glob per line.
filters.targetBranchesHelp: Leave empty for all branches. Supports * and **.
filters.requiredLabelsHelp: All listed labels must be present.
filters.excludedLabelsHelp: Any listed label prevents automatic review.
filters.mentionBypass: Reviews requested by @mention bypass these scheduling filters. Repository access and ignored files still apply.

ignored.title: Ignored files
ignored.filePatternsHelp: Excluded from all reviews, including @mentions. One pattern per line; supports * and **.

inline.title: Inline comment options
inline.hiddenFindings: Hidden findings still count in the assessment.

decisions.title: Approvals and change requests
decisions.description: Optional formal decisions on GitHub. Scores, comments, and checks still work when these are off.
decisions.allowApprovalsHelp: Lets the agent submit an Approve review on GitHub after a complete assessment. The agent must explicitly choose it; a 5/5 score or passing check does not approve the PR. Off still allows scores, comments, and checks.
decisions.allowRequestChangesHelp: Lets the agent submit a Request changes review on GitHub after a complete assessment. This is a formal review decision and may prevent merging under your repository rules. Off still allows findings, comments, and a failing check.

access.peopleDescription: Choose who can mention this bot and whose activity can start work automatically.
access.allowAllLinked: Allow mentions from all linked members
access.allowAllLinkedOn: Includes members from {{company}} who link their GitHub account later.
access.allowAllLinkedOff: Only members you enable below can mention this bot.
access.noMembersLinked: No members linked yet. Link an account to get started.
access.automaticOnBefore: Automatic runs use the events and author filters in
access.externalDescription: Allow specific GitHub users with a member as their sponsor. They receive restricted access, without company membership or the sponsor’s personal credentials.
access.allowExternalAutomatic: Allow automatic runs for external contributors
access.allowExternalAutomaticOn: Authorized contributors can trigger the events and author filters configured in Settings.
access.allowExternalAutomaticOff: Turn on automatic runs in Settings first. Mentions remain available.

responsibility.title: Automatic task responsibility
responsibility.description: The member accountable for automatically created Paperclip tasks. GitHub authors remain recorded separately. This grants no access to the member’s personal credentials. Only company owners, company admins, and instance admins can select another person as a sponsor or responsible member.

access.loadAction: load members, linked accounts, and your access

dialog.memberDescription: Each member confirms their own GitHub identity. Share this link with an existing company member, or link your own account.
dialog.guestDescription: Allow a GitHub user to mention this bot. A company member must sponsor their restricted access.
dialog.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Open account linking and copy the address.
dialog.found: Found @{{login}}. They will be able to mention the bot after you save.
